pages.text: Mom did the morning washing. Mumu's blue neck scarf was clean too.
"I'll hang my scarf myself." Mumu took it from the basket.
Dodo pointed to a branch. "Hang washing high, and the wind dries it well. I know! That branch is perfect!" Mumu held out the scarf. "Then you try, Dodo."
Dodo draped it on the high branch. A strong wind blew.
Flutter! The scarf flew like a bird. "Catch it!"
It landed softly on a blade of the waterwheel. Round and round it rode.
Dodo hopped and hopped. The scarf went high, then low. "The wind and the waterwheel are on the same team!"
Mumu called Dad. Dad stopped the wheel with a clunk. The scarf stopped right before them.
Mumu gently pulled it free. Half was still damp, half was dry.
Mumu hung it firmly on the yard clothesline. Dodo said, "The waterwheel dried half for us!" The scarf fluttered as if laughing.
